verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a general webhooks system that avoids polling and delivers final outcomes for asynchronous processes, plus a separate Disputes API for retrieving/managing disputes, covering authorized/captured/refunded/disputed events conceptually. However, evidence is generic platform-level docs (not POS-specific webhook payloads for capture/refund lifecycle) and a community complaint highlights painful integration friction for card-present flows, so delivery is credible but with caveats.
